Football Club Kharkiv, formerly FC Metalist 1925 Kharkiv is a professional football club from Kharkiv, Ukraine. Founded in 2016, the club plays in the Ukrainian Premier League, the top tier of Ukrainian football after promotion from the Ukrainian First League in 2024–25. Their home stadium is the Metalist State Sports Complex, with 40,003 capacity.
